findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: portfolio, account_request_message · Private data: vlad_check_eligibility, vlad_claim_transaction, vlad_withdraw_gains_transaction, vlad_withdraw_transaction, vlad_contribute_transaction, vlad_standing_order, vlad_standing_order_transactions, vlad_cancel_standing_order_transaction, portfolio, list_factors, account_request_message, open_account, balance_sheet, deposit, pay, withdraw, fire_factor, stealth_address, merca_lock_status, merca_lock, merca_request_unlock, merca_unlock, delivery_key_typed_data, register_delivery_key, read_outbox, shielded_status · Public sink: vlad_program, vlad_claim_transaction, vlad_withdraw_gains_transaction, vlad_withdraw_transaction, vlad_standing_order_transactions, portfolio, open_account, deposit, choose_factor, set_mandate, pay, withdraw, fire_factor, stealth_address, merca_lock_status, merca_lock · Destructive: account_request_message, open_account, delete_outbox_item, shielded_status.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
